content:
**Ground Mole Rat** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

Minced mole rat which has been cooked with beans and spices to create a post-apocalyptic chili dish.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Mole Rat Meat (2) Pepper (2) Silt Bean (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Ground Molerat | | Ground Mole Rat (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after learning the Recipe.
